"""Qualify the committed recovery evidence without an ignored source view."""
import argparse
import copy
import gzip
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from capture import BASE, canonical, pin, save
import deliver
import view

SUCCESS = 'PASS unchanged original association recovery, retained failures and committed-state-only evidence; full raw-parent and native/private acceptance remain open.\n'
FINAL_LABELS = ('verify-seal-v2', 'verify-default', 'staged-doctrines')
EXCLUDED = {'seal.json'} | {n + suffix for n in FINAL_LABELS for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}


def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def read(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / name).read_bytes())


def gate(label, status, command=None, expected=None):
    row = read(label + '-actual.json')
    started = read(label + '-started.json')
    need(all(row[k] == v for k, v in started.items()), 'whole started native declaration ' + label)
    need(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == status
         and row['expected_status'] == (status if expected is None else expected), 'typed actual and declared gate terminal ' + label)
    if label == 'size':
        changed = {'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py', 't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py'}
        need(row['programmes'].keys() == row['programmes_after'].keys()
             and {n for n in row['programmes'] if row['programmes'][n] != row['programmes_after'][n]} == changed,
             'exact retained prepublication size instrument drift; unqualified epoch')
        for name in changed:
            raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
            need(row['programmes_after'][name] == dict(body=raw.decode(), identity=pin(raw)),
                 'complete strengthened source boundary after unqualified first size gate')
    else:
        need(row['programmes'] == row['programmes_after'], 'whole instrument epoch ' + label)
    need(command is None or row['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command], 'exact native gate command ' + label)
    for name, entry in row['programmes'].items():
        raw = entry['body'].encode()
        need(pin(raw) == entry['identity'], 'whole actual programme body ' + label)
        if name == str(BASE / 'view.py'):
            need(raw in (Path(name).read_bytes(), (BASE / 'view-first.py.txt').read_bytes()), 'explicit first or repaired view body')
        elif name == str(BASE / 'verify.py'):
            need(raw in [Path(name).read_bytes(), *[(BASE / ('verify-' + role + '.py.txt')).read_bytes()
                         for role in ('first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth')]], 'explicit retained qualifier body')
        elif name == str(BASE / 'deliver.py'):
            need(raw in (Path(name).read_bytes(), (BASE / 'deliver-first.py.txt').read_bytes()), 'explicit first or corrected delivery body')
        elif name in ('scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py', 't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py'):
            first = 'recovery-first.py.txt' if name.startswith('scripts/') else 'tests-first.py.txt'
            need(raw in (Path(name).read_bytes(), (BASE / first).read_bytes()), 'explicit dated or strengthened source boundary')
        else:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'unchanged direct programme ' + name)
    if status == 0 or label == 'original-before-v2':
        need(re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', row['stderr']) is not None,
             'unchanged complete RAM guard diagnostic ' + label)
    return row


def native(row, role, members):
    need(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == (0 if role == 'after' else 1), 'typed original native terminal')
    need(row['command'] == ['python3', '-B', str(view.ASSOCIATION / 'verify.py')]
         and row['cwd'] == row['git_work_tree'] == str(view.VIEW) and row['git_directory'] == '.git',
         'whole unchanged original reader command and explicit own Git context')
    need(row['inputs'] == row['inputs_after'], 'whole original before/after source epoch')
    expected = dict(members)
    receipt = json.loads((view.ASSOCIATION / 'checks.json').read_bytes())
    if role == 'after':
        for gate_row in receipt.values():
            for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                name = gate_row[stream + '_path']
                need(name not in expected, 'disjoint original source and recovered streams')
                expected[name] = dict(**pin(gate_row[stream].encode()), executable=False)
    directories = {'.'} | {str(p) for name in expected for p in Path(name).parents}
    need(row['inputs'] == dict(members=expected, directories=sorted(directories)), 'whole exact source population and stream bodies')
    programmes = {name: dict(body=Path(name).read_text(), identity=pin(Path(name).read_bytes()))
                  for name in members if name.startswith(str(view.ASSOCIATION) + '/') and name.endswith('.py')}
    need(row['programmes'] == programmes, 'whole original direct reader programme population')
    for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        need(Path(row[stream + '_path']).read_bytes() == row[stream].encode(), 'whole tracked original native stream')
    if role == 'after':
        need(row['stdout'] == 'PASS unchanged complete original raw-body association acceptance; full raw semantic parent, canonical publication and original native/private scopes remain open.\n'
             and row['stderr'] == '', 'actual unchanged original reader success')
    else:
        need(row['stdout'] == '' and 'line 77, in actual' in row['stderr']
             and row['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: complete ordinary admission member\n'), 'actual intended missing-stream refusal')


def core():
    source = read('source.json')
    need(source == view.source(), 'complete original committed source graph declaration')
    for name, entry in source['members'].items():
        need(view.file_identity(Path(name)) == entry, 'whole original source bytes and mode ' + name)
    for role in ('before', 'after'):
        row = read('reader-' + role + '-actual.json')
        started = read('reader-' + role + '-started.json')
        need(all(row[k] == v for k, v in started.items()), 'whole original started declaration')
        native(row, role, source['members'])
    for label in ('original-before', 'original-after'):
        row = gate(label, 1, expected=1 if label == 'original-before' else 0)
        need(row['stdout'] == '' and 'explicit ordinary work-tree root' in row['stderr'], 'first harness failure retains as non-success')
    for role, status in (('before', 1), ('after', 0)):
        row = gate('original-' + role + '-v2', status, ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'view.py'), '--reader', role])
        need(row['stdout'] == 'Original complete association reader native status ' + str(status) + '\n', 'outer and inner actual terminal agreement')
    streams = read('reader-after-actual.json')['inputs']['members']
    created = sorted(str(view.VIEW / n) for n in streams if n not in source['members'])
    for label in ('restore-view', 'restore-view-v2', 'restore-view-again', 'check-view'):
        row = gate(label, 0)
        result = json.loads(row['stdout'])
        need(result['root'] == str(view.VIEW) and result['sources'] == [str(view.ASSOCIATION / 'checks.json')]
             and result['created'] == (created if label in ('restore-view', 'restore-view-v2') else []), 'actual exact recovery/idempotence result')
        need(result['streams'] == [dict(path=str(view.VIEW / n), **{k: streams[n][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')})
                                  for n in sorted(streams) if n not in source['members']], 'whole actual reconstructed stream census')
    unit = gate('unit-first', 0)
    need('Ran 17 tests in ' in unit['stderr'] and '\nOK\n' in unit['stderr'], 'complete permanent controls native success')
    current_unit = gate('unit-v2', 0)
    need('Ran 18 tests in ' in current_unit['stderr'] and '\nOK\n' in current_unit['stderr'],
         'complete strengthened source-file and original recovery controls native success')
    history = gate('root-history', 0)
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{40} .+\n', history['stdout']) is not None, 'actual Git pickaxe root cause')
    for label, message in (('recovery-core', 'typed actual gate terminal original-after'),
                           ('recovery-core-v2', 'unchanged complete RAM guard diagnostic unit-first')):
        failed = gate(label, 1, expected=0)
        need(failed['stdout'] == '' and failed['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: ' + message + '\n'),
             'first actual qualifier failure remains non-success')
    qualified = gate('recovery-core-v3', 0)
    need(qualified['stdout'] == 'PASS unchanged original reader before/after, complete source custody and permanent controls.\n',
         'separate complete corrected qualifier result')
    failed_delivery = gate('delivery', 1, expected=0)
    need(failed_delivery['stdout'] == '' and failed_delivery['stderr'].endswith("KeyError: 'surface_id'\n"),
         'first delivery preflight remains non-success')
    first_size = gate('size', 1, expected=0)
    need('surface task_evidence transition debt exceeded its owned allowance' in first_size['stderr'],
         'first prepublication task-growth refusal remains non-success')
    first_seal = gate('verify-seal', 1, expected=0)
    need(first_seal['stdout'] == '' and first_seal['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: whole instrument epoch size\n'),
         'first seal refusal retains the unqualified earlier instrument drift')
    # Same original native qualifier, genuine metadata interventions. The
    # filesystem and CLI falsification leg is the separately executed unit suite.
    positive = read('reader-after-actual.json')
    mutations = [('Boolean status', lambda r: r.update(status=False)),
                 ('changed command', lambda r: r['command'].append('--borrowed')),
                 ('omitted source', lambda r: r['inputs']['members'].pop(next(iter(source['members']))))]
    for name, mutate in mutations:
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(positive)
        mutate(candidate)
        try:
            native(candidate, 'after', source['members'])
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise ValueError('hostile native candidate accepted: ' + name)
    return source


def delivery():
    row = read('delivery.json')
    sources = {}
    for name, epochs in row['snapshots'].items():
        sources[name] = {}
        for role, entry in epochs.items():
            body = gzip.decompress(Path(entry['snapshot']).read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole retained delivery snapshot')
            sources[name][role] = body
    amendment = read('final-amendment.json')
    amended = {}
    need(amendment['owner'] == deliver.OWNER and set(amendment['snapshots']) == {str(deliver.TASK), str(deliver.REGISTRY)},
         'exact owned final qualification amendment population')
    for name, epochs in amendment['snapshots'].items():
        amended[name] = {}
        for role, entry in epochs.items():
            body = gzip.decompress(Path(entry['snapshot']).read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole final qualification amendment snapshot')
            amended[name][role] = body
        need(amended[name]['before'] == sources[name]['after'], 'exact whole delivered amendment predecessor')
    original_task = sources[str(deliver.TASK)]['after']
    block = deliver.nodes(original_task)[deliver.OWNER]
    needle = b'  Acceptance Checklist (enforced):\n'
    need(block.count(needle) == 1 and amended[str(deliver.TASK)]['after'] ==
         original_task.replace(block, block.replace(needle, amendment['addition'].encode() + needle, 1), 1),
         'only exact owning final-qualification finding supplements task delivery')
    tasks = {n: Path(n).read_bytes() for n in row['task_names']}
    measured = deliver.metrics(tasks)
    need(measured == amendment['task_metrics'], 'complete final task collection measurement')
    authority = [json.loads(line) for line in sources[str(deliver.REGISTRY)]['after'].splitlines()]
    for entry in authority:
        if entry.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            for key, value in measured.items():
                need(value <= entry['enforcement_ceilings'][key], 'unchanged final task ceiling')
                entry['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0, value + entry['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - entry['baseline'][key])
    need(amended[str(deliver.REGISTRY)]['after'] == b''.join(canonical(entry) for entry in authority),
         'only measured owned task allowance changes; book authority and all ceilings conserve')
    for name in amended:
        sources[name]['after'] = amended[name]['after']
    for name in sources:
        need(Path(name).read_bytes() == sources[name]['after'], 'whole current delivered source ' + name)
    before = sources[str(deliver.BOOK)]['before']
    command = b'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/verify.py\n'
    need(before == deliver.git('show', deliver.REVISION + ':' + str(deliver.BOOK))
         and sources[str(deliver.BOOK)]['after'] == before.replace(row['old_notice'].encode(), row['notice'].encode(), 1).replace(command, row['prepare'].encode() + command, 1), 'exact bounded own book replacement and public preparation')
    original = deliver.nodes(gzip.decompress((BASE / 'activation-task.md.gz').read_bytes()))
    final = deliver.nodes(sources[str(deliver.TASK)]['after'])
    need(original.keys() == final.keys(), 'complete original task graph after repair')
    for key in original:
        if key != deliver.OWNER:
            need(original[key] == final[key], 'whole unrelated task node conserves')
        for field in ('Goal', 'Acceptance'):
            pattern = rb'^  ' + field.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$'
            a, b = re.search(pattern, original[key], re.M), re.search(pattern, final[key], re.M)
            need((a[1] if a else None) == (b[1] if b else None), 'every original task contract conserves')
    need(b'  Status: `done`\n' in final[deliver.OWNER], 'only owning repair closes')
    for label in ('delivery-v2', 'book-prepare-v2', 'focused-v3', 'book-v2', 'native-copy-v2', 'size-v3', 'claims-v3', 'inventory-write-v3', 'inventory-v3'):
        actual = gate(label, 0)
        if label == 'focused-v3':
            need('All tests successful' in actual['stdout'], 'actual permanent integration and focused regression success')


def catalogue():
    return {str(p): dict(**pin(p.read_bytes()), executable=bool(p.stat().st_mode & 0o111))
            for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name not in EXCLUDED}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--core', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(not (args.core and args.seal), 'one explicit qualification role')
    source = core()
    if args.core:
        print('PASS unchanged original reader before/after, complete source custody and permanent controls.')
        return
    delivery()
    seal = dict(owner=deliver.OWNER, files=catalogue(), original_source=pin(canonical(source)),
                scope='Committed recovery evidence only; no ignored view required, no original reader reexecution, full raw-parent/native/private scopes remain open.')
    if args.seal:
        save('seal.json', seal)
    else:
        need(read('seal.json') == seal, 'complete committed recovery evidence and source mode custody')
    print(SUCCESS, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Save each complete native guard terminal outside the guarded process tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/raw-semantic-parent-closure-20261011')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py'}
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    return {name: dict(body=(raw := Path(name).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw)) for name in sorted(names)}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-parent-closure-20261011/checks') / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if type(result.returncode) is not int or result.returncode != args.expect or epoch != actual['programmes_after']:
        raise SystemExit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Restore missing audit gate streams from explicit, unchanged committed receipts."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import stat
import subprocess

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def relative(value, allow_dot=False):
    require(type(value) is str and value and '\\' not in value and '\x00' not in value
            and '\n' not in value and '\r' not in value, 'ordinary relative path text')
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    require(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts)
            and path.as_posix() == value and (value != '.' or allow_dot),
            'canonical repository-relative path')
    return Path(value)


def local(path):
    """Read-only preflight; never create a directory or follow a link."""
    current = REPO
    device = REPO.stat().st_dev
    for index, part in enumerate(path.parts):
        current = current / part
        require(not current.is_symlink(), 'symlink boundary refused')
        if current.exists():
            info = current.lstat()
            require(info.st_dev == device, 'same-volume boundary required')
            require(index == len(path.parts) - 1 or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode),
                    'ordinary directory ancestor required')
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                require(not os.path.lexists(current / '.git'), 'nested Git boundary refused')
    return current


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        require(key not in result, 'duplicate receipt object key')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def committed_receipts(names):
    result = []
    for name in names:
        path = relative(name)
        require(len(path.parts) == 4 and path.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and path.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        descriptor = os.open(local(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as stream:
            before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_dev == REPO.stat().st_dev,
                    'ordinary same-volume committed receipt file required')
            raw = stream.read()
            after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require((before.st_ino, before.st_dev, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                    (after.st_ino, after.st_dev, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
                    and len(raw) == before.st_size, 'complete stable committed receipt read')
        native = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), '--no-replace-objects',
                                 'show', 'HEAD:' + name], capture_output=True)
        require(type(native.returncode) is int and native.returncode == 0
                and native.stderr == b'' and native.stdout == raw,
                'complete receipt must match committed HEAD bytes')
        records = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        result.append((name, records))
    return result


def plan(receipts, root='.'):
    """Validate every source, target and existing body before any filesystem write."""
    root_path = relative(root, allow_dot=True)
    require(local(root_path).is_dir(), 'existing ordinary destination root required')
    targets = {}
    for name, records in receipts:
        source = relative(name)
        require(len(source.parts) == 4 and source.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and source.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        namespace = source.parts[2]
        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', namespace) is not None,
                'ordinary audit namespace required')
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        for label, row in records.items():
            require(type(label) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', label) is not None
                    and type(row) is dict and type(row.get('status')) is int,
                    'complete typed terminal gate required')
            for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                require(type(row.get(stream)) is str and type(row.get(stream + '_path')) is str,
                        'complete stream text and path required')
                path = relative(row[stream + '_path'])
                expected = Path('.artifacts') / namespace / 'checks' / label / (stream + '.txt')
                require(path == expected, 'stream path must match its declared audit gate')
                body = row[stream].encode('utf-8')
                target = root_path / path
                key = target.as_posix()
                if key in targets:
                    require(targets[key]['body'] == body, 'contradictory duplicate stream target')
                else:
                    targets[key] = dict(path=target, body=body)
    for row in targets.values():
        target = local(row['path'])
        row['present'] = target.exists()
        if row['present']:
            info = target.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1,
                    'existing stream must be an ordinary unshared file')
            require(target.read_bytes() == row['body'], 'existing stream bytes conflict')
    return [targets[name] for name in sorted(targets)]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def parent_directory(path):
    """Open each directory without following links, including during installation."""
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    descriptors = [os.open(REPO, flags)]
    device = os.fstat(descriptors[0]).st_dev
    try:
        for part in path.parts:
            parent = descriptors[-1]
            try:
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                os.mkdir(part, mode=0o700, dir_fd=parent)
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(child)
            require(os.fstat(child).st_dev == device, 'same-volume directory required at installation')
            try:
                os.stat('.git', dir_fd=child, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError('nested Git boundary refused at installation')
        yield descriptors[-1]
    finally:
        for descriptor in reversed(descriptors):
            os.close(descriptor)


def install(rows):
    created = []
    for row in rows:
        if row['present']:
            continue
        path, body = row['path'], row['body']
        with parent_directory(path.parent) as directory:
            temporary = '.restore-stream-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
            descriptor = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                 0o600, dir_fd=directory)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'wb') as stream:
                    stream.write(body)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                # A complete body becomes visible atomically; an existing target is never replaced.
                os.link(temporary, path.name, src_dir_fd=directory, dst_dir_fd=directory,
                        follow_symlinks=False)
                created.append(path.as_posix())
            finally:
                os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=directory)
    return created


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--receipts', nargs='+', required=True,
                        help='explicit committed docs/audits/NAMESPACE/checks.json sources')
    parser.add_argument('--root', default='.', help='existing ordinary repository-relative destination root')
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true', help='require all exact streams without writing')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipts = committed_receipts(args.receipts)
    rows = plan(receipts, args.root)
    if args.check:
        require(all(row['present'] for row in rows), 'complete streams not yet materialized')
        created = []
    else:
        created = install(rows)
    after = plan(receipts, args.root)
    require(all(row['present'] for row in after), 'complete exact stream installation required')

"""Permanent filesystem and receipt controls for missing-only stream recovery."""
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stream_recovery', REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
SOURCE = 'docs/audits/test-gates/checks.json'


def records(label='one', text='exact\n'):
    return {label: dict(status=0, stdout=text, stderr='',
        stdout_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stdout.txt',
        stderr_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stderr.txt')}


class StreamRecovery(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        base = recovery.local(Path('.artifacts/gate-stream-tests'))
        base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='case-', dir=base)
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        self.folder = REPO / self.root

    def census(self):
        return {p.relative_to(self.folder).as_posix(): (p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else None)
                for p in self.folder.rglob('*') if not p.is_symlink()}

    def refused(self, candidate, reason, sources=None):
        before = self.census()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, reason):
            recovery.plan(sources or [(SOURCE, candidate)], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), before)

    def test_exact_empty_stream_and_idempotence(self):
        source = records(text='unicode: \u03bb\r\nterminal space \n')
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(recovery.install(rows)), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(r['present'] for r in recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)))
        before = self.census()
        self.assertEqual(recovery.install(recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), before)
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']).read_bytes(), source['one']['stdout'].encode())
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stderr_path']).read_bytes(), b'')
        self.assertFalse(any('.restore-stream-' in p.name for p in self.folder.rglob('*')))

    def test_conflict_is_refused_before_creating_other_targets(self):
        source = records('aaa') | records('zzz')
        target = self.folder / source['zzz']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.write_bytes(b'conflict')
        self.refused(source, 'existing stream bytes conflict')
        self.assertFalse((self.folder / source['aaa']['stdout_path']).parent.exists())

    def test_identical_duplicates_conserve(self):
        source = records()
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source), (SOURCE, copy.deepcopy(source))], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)

    def test_contradictory_duplicates_refuse(self):
        source = records()
        self.refused(source, 'contradictory duplicate', [(SOURCE, source), (SOURCE, records(text='different'))])

    def test_missing_stream_text(self):
        source = records()
        del source['one']['stderr']
        self.refused(source, 'complete stream text')

    def test_missing_terminal(self):
        source = records()
        del source['one']['status']
        self.refused(source, 'complete typed terminal')

    def test_boolean_terminal(self):
        source = records()
        source['one']['status'] = False
        self.refused(source, 'complete typed terminal')

    def test_nonzero_terminal_is_preserved_as_text(self):
        source = records()
        source['one']['status'] = 255
        source['one']['stderr'] = 'actual original refusal\n'
        recovery.install(recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root))
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stderr_path']).read_text(), 'actual original refusal\n')
        self.assertEqual(source['one']['status'], 255)

    def test_unsafe_paths_refuse(self):
        for path in ('/outside/stdout.txt', '../stdout.txt', '.git/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts//test-gates/checks/one/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/test-gates/checks/one/../stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/foreign/checks/one/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/test-gates/checks/another/stdout.txt'):
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                source = records()
                source['one']['stdout_path'] = path
                self.refused(source, 'relative path|declared audit gate')

    def test_symlink_ancestor_refuses(self):
        destination = self.folder / 'elsewhere'
        destination.mkdir()
        (self.folder / '.artifacts').symlink_to(destination, target_is_directory=True)
        self.refused(records(), 'symlink boundary')

    def test_symlink_target_refuses(self):
        source = records()
        target = self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.symlink_to(self.folder / 'absent')
        self.refused(source, 'symlink boundary')

    def test_nested_git_marker_refuses(self):
        # A dummy marker is sufficient; no second Git repository is created or modified.
        target = self.folder / '.artifacts'
        target.mkdir()
        (target / '.git').write_text('fixture boundary marker\n')
        self.refused(records(), 'nested Git boundary')

    def test_non_directory_ancestor_refuses_before_writes(self):
        (self.folder / '.artifacts').write_bytes(b'ordinary file')
        self.refused(records(), 'ordinary directory ancestor')

    def test_existing_hardlink_refuses(self):
        source = records()
        target = self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        original = self.folder / 'shared'
        original.write_text(source['one']['stdout'])
        os.link(original, target)
        self.refused(source, 'ordinary unshared file')

    def test_install_never_replaces_a_racing_target(self):
        source = records()
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)
        target = self.folder / rows[0]['path'].relative_to(self.root)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.write_bytes(b'concurrent writer')
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            recovery.install(rows)
        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), b'concurrent writer')
        self.assertFalse(any('.restore-stream-' in p.name for p in self.folder.rglob('*')))

    def test_duplicate_json_keys_refuse(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'duplicate receipt object key'):
            json.loads('{"status":0,"status":255}', object_pairs_hook=recovery.unique_object)

    def test_nonregular_receipt_refuses_without_reading(self):
        fifo = self.folder / 'receipt-fifo'
        os.mkfifo(fifo)
        with patch.object(recovery, 'local', return_value=fifo):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ordinary same-volume committed receipt'):
                recovery.committed_receipts([SOURCE])
        self.assertEqual(fifo.stat().st_size, 0)

    def test_real_committed_receipt_cli_check_and_replay(self):
        command = ['python3', '-B', str(REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py'),
                   '--receipts', 'docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json', '--root', self.root]
        before = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(before.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('complete streams not yet materialized', before.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), {})
        first = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((first.returncode, first.stderr), (0, ''))
        result = json.loads(first.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(result['created'])
        source = recovery.committed_receipts(['docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json'])
        expected = recovery.plan(source, self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(result['streams']), len(expected))
        second = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        third = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((second.returncode, second.stderr, third.returncode, third.stderr), (0, '', 0, ''))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(third.stdout)['created'], [])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
